title: Red panda with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='24' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='24' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='24' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#ff8c69'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='24' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#ff8c69'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='30' ry='26' fill='#e05d2b'/>
  <!-- face white patches -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='18' ry='15' fill='#fff4e6'/>
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='52' rx='11' ry='12' fill='#fff4e6'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='52' rx='11' ry='12' fill='#fff4e6'/>
  <!-- eye patches (dark lit brown) -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='49' rx='8' ry='9' fill='#5a2d1c'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='49' rx='8' ry='9' fill='#5a2d1c'/>
  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='49' r='5.5' fill='#1b1b2f'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='49' r='5.5' fill='#1b1b2f'/>
  <circle cx='38.5' cy='47' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='64.5' cy='47' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='35.5' cy='51' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='51' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='59' rx='4.5' ry='3.5' fill='#3d1a0e'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M46 63 Q50 67 54 63' stroke='#5a2d1c' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek sparkles -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='60' r='1.2' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='60' r='1.2' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- fluffy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='55' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#fff4e6'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='55' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#fff4e6'/>
</svg>
